title: 2020 Panini Mosaic #282 Brian Urlacher Chicago Bears Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2020 Panini Mosaic Hall of Fame sports trading card features the legendary football player Brian Urlacher of the Chicago Bears. The card is a standard size and part of the 2020 Panini Mosaic set, with a beautiful Mosaic parallel/variety. It is perfect for any fan of the National Football League (NFL) and sports trading cards.

The card is not autographed and has a card number of 282. It is a great addition to any collection and a must-have for fans of Brian Urlacher and the Chicago Bears. Get your hands on this stunning card today!
